summary.text: Abdi Daisane is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 14A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Michael Conway after advancing from the August 11 Democratic primary.
He graduated from St. Cloud State University and was the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Abdi Daisane graduated from St. Cloud State University.
In 2024 he was the Democratic nominee for Minnesota House District 14A and lost to incumbent Republican Bernie Perryman, 56.3 percent to 43.5 percent.
